agm.agm_result:
Agenda #1: Shareholders approved the 2025 Annual Report, Board of Commissioners' Oversight Report, and audited Financial Statements, granting full discharge to the Board of Directors and Commissioners.
Agenda #2: The meeting allocated 65% of the 2025 Net Profit (Rp13.02 trillion) as cash dividends and 35% (Rp7.01 trillion) as retained earnings.
Agenda #3: Authority was granted to Series B and C shareholders to set 2026 remuneration for the Board of Commissioners, while the Board of Commissioners will set 2026 remuneration for Directors.
Agenda #4: Shareholders appointed KAP Rintis, Jumadi, Rianto & Rekan (PwC) to audit the 2026 Consolidated Financial Statements and PUMK reports.
Agenda #5: Authority was delegated to the Board of Commissioners, with Series B and C shareholder approval, to approve the 2026-2030 Long-Term Work Plan and 2027 Annual Work Plan.
Agenda #6: The meeting approved a share buyback program with a maximum budget of Rp905.48 billion and authorized the use of treasury stock for resale or employee ownership programs.
Agenda #7: Shareholders approved the reclassification of 223,783,877 Series B shares to Series A Dwiwarna shares to comply with Law No. 16 of 2025 and authorized the resulting amendments to the Articles of Association.
Agenda #8: The meeting formally accepted the report regarding the realization of funds from the Phase I 2025 Sustainability Bond public offering.
Agenda #9: Authority was delegated to the Board of Commissioners to approve changes to the Pension Fund Regulations while maintaining prudent governance and financial stability.
